title: Release of National Formulary of India 2026
bodyHtml:
Release of National Formulary of India 2026

The 7th edition of the National Formulary of India, 2026 (NFI 2026) has been released on 21.09.2026 by Smt. Anupriya Patel, Hon’ble Minister of Health & Family Welfare and Chemicals & Fertilizers, Government of India at the 6th National Pharmacovigilance Week organised by the Indian Pharmacopoeia Commission (IPC) at Dr. Ambedkar International Centre, New Delhi. The 7th Edition of NFl is released in both print and digital versions. The principal objective of NFI is to promote rational use of medicines.

Please send your feedback to

The Secretary-cum-Scientific Director,

Indian Pharmacopoeia Commission,
Raj Nagar, Sector-23 Ghaziabad-201002
Email: lab.ipc@gov.in

The price of NFI 2026:

₹ 660 + 5% GST (digital version)

₹ 800/- (printed version)

₹ 1000 + 5% GST (both digital & printed version).

With a view to promote rational use of medicines Smt. Anupriya Patel, Hon’ble Minister of State for Health & Family Welfare and Chemicals & Fertilizers, Government of India released National Formulary of India (NFI) 2026 at Dr. Ambedkar International Centre, New Delhi on 21.09.2026.
